title: Interference Free Towers
brief: A city is laid out as an n by n grid of blocks, and we must install exactly n radio towers, at most one per block. Two towers interfere if they share a row, a column, or any diagonal of the grid, no matter how far apart they are.
Implement countSafeLayouts(n), where n is the grid size and the number of towers, and return how many different layouts place all n towers with no two interfering.
